## Common WHERE Filters

该表在所有查询中以全表扫描方式使用，不加任何 WHERE 过滤条件。作为白名单维度表，通常只需读取全部 `scene_id` 和 `layer_id`。

## Common JOIN Patterns

### JOIN on scene_id — 过滤搜索场景的 AB 实验命中

```sql
select group_id, user_id, base_group_info.scene_id, layer_id
from (
    select group_id, user_id, scene_id, layer_id
    from traffic.shopee_traffic_dws_abtest_hit_log_di__reg_live
    where tz_type = 'local'
      and grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
    union all
    select group_id, user_id, scene_id, layer_id
    from abtest.abtest_mart_dws_assignment_agg_1d
    where local_date = date('${grass_date}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
) base_group_info
inner join (
    select scene_id
    from mp_paidads.dim_seach_scene_white_list__reg_s0_live
) search_scene
on base_group_info.scene_id = search_scene.scene_id
```

**用途**：从 AB test 命中日志中筛选搜索类场景的用户分组。通过 scene_id 与白名单 JOIN，只保留搜索场景的实验组用户。

### JOIN on layer_id — 过滤搜索实验层

```sql
select group_id, user_id, scene_id, search_layer.layer_id
from (

    from traffic.shopee_traffic_dws_abtest_hit_log_di__reg_live
    where tz_type = 'local'
      and grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
    union all
    select group_id, user_id, scene_id, layer_id
    from abtest.abtest_mart_dws_assignment_agg_1d
    where local_date = date('${grass_date}')
      and grass_region = upper('${region}')
) base_group_info
inner join (
    select layer_id
    from mp_paidads.dim_seach_scene_white_list__reg_s0_live
) search_layer
on base_group_info.layer_id = search_layer.layer_id
```

**用途**：通过 layer_id 与白名单 JOIN，筛选搜索相关 AB 实验层的用户分组。

## Representative SQL Snippets

### Snippet 1: 场景白名单 + 实验层白名单联合过滤（典型用法）

```sql
-- prepare search group_id && user_id
-- Global Search、Image Search、Shop Game、Games、Search Shop
create or replace temporary view search_group
as
select group_id, user_id
from (
    select group_id, user_id, base_group_info.scene_id, layer_id
    from (
        select group_id, user_id, scene_id, layer_id
        from traffic.shopee_traffic_dws_abtest_hit_log_di__reg_live
        where tz_type = 'local'
          and grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
          and grass_region = upper('${region}')
        union all
        select group_id, user_id, scene_id, layer_id
        from abtest.abtest_mart_dws_assignment_agg_1d
        where local_date = date('${grass_date}')
          and grass_region = upper('${region}')
    ) base_group_info
    inner join (
        select scene_id
        from mp_paidads.dim_seach_scene_white_list__reg_s0_live
    ) search_scene
    on base_group_info.scene_id = search_scene.scene_id
    union all
    select group_id, user_id, scene_id, search_layer.layer_id
    from (
        select group_id, user_id, scene_id, layer_id
        from traffic.shopee_traffic_dws_abtest_hit_log_di__reg_live
        where tz_type = 'local'
          and grass_date = date('${grass_date}')
          and grass_region = upper('${region}')
        union all
        select group_id, user_id, scene_id, layer_id
        from abtest.abtest_mart_dws_assignment_agg_1d
        where local_date = date('${grass_date}')
          and grass_region = upper('${region}')
    ) base_group_info
    inner join (
        select layer_id
        from mp_paidads.dim_seach_scene_white_list__reg_s0_live
    ) search_layer
    on base_group_info.layer_id = search_layer.layer_id
) group by group_id, user_id;
```

**说明**：先通过 scene_id JOIN 白名单过滤搜索场景用户，再通过 layer_id JOIN 白名单补充过滤搜索实验层用户，UNION ALL 合并两组用户后去重。
